﻿Instant Haunted House Effect: Transform any space into a chilling scene—perfect for Halloween parties, haunted trails, zombie walks, and horror movie nights.

summary.text: Customers find the Halloween stickers visually appealing, particularly for birthday themes, and appreciate their quality and functionality. They are easy to put on and take off, and work well for parties. However, customers report significant issues with removal - the stickers don't come off easily and leave residue that's hard to remove. Moreover, durability is a concern as they peel during application, and customers disagree on whether the product is worth the money.

authors_reviews.title: Cute! But one use only
authors_reviews.text: Very easy to apply, they're pretty sticky and kept place (except the ones on the windows, the panes were dirty). It looked great on my toilet, tub, floor, window, mirror, and shower! Everything removed fairly easily. It came off my tub and toilet with ease, two did leave a residue that was a little difficult to clean. The stickers on the mirror however took A LOT to remove and then after to remove residue as well. On the floor they stayed put (it's the bathroom so the floors get wet and they didn't budge) they came off with little effort, and looked great!
authors_reviews.author: Mikelle

authors_reviews.title: Looks real! Very fun for parties
authors_reviews.text: Absolutely loved adding these to the white tile in the bathroom as a 'surprise' for Halloween party guests. Looked great! Had a few that left some slight adhesive behind which I didn't notice until they started collecting dust/dirt. Pretty easy to take care of with a magic eraser.
authors_reviews.author: Chris C.

authors_reviews.title: Great for Halloween party

authors_reviews.title: Great party decor
authors_reviews.text: These were great! Easy to put on and take off. It came with pages and pages of design which covered one bathroom with plenty left for a hallway or another bathroom. Peeling off was a bit tougher after a few days but the residue came off easy.
authors_reviews.author: Meghan S

authors_reviews.title: Buyer beware!
authors_reviews.text: We bought these for a summerween party, they do stick very, very well. We used them on windows and bathroom mirrors. Now removing them was a joke. The scrappers they include do nothing to help. I had to use a razor to remove and even then it was difficult. Once you’re done struggling to remove you find that it leaves a sticky residue behind. The only thing that worked for me to remove the residue was Goo Gone. I rubbed that on the residue and then used the razor again to remove. Wish I had read reviews before purchasing. Also you’ll cannot reuse them. Do not purchase them unless you’re into lots of hard work to remove!
authors_reviews.author: Elaine Amaya
